name: discovery-bay-jamaica-1966-1968-eileen-graham
title: The Eileen Graham Collection (Discovery Bay, Jamaica, 1966 to 1968)
description: Historical coral reef photographs taken at Discovery Bay, Jamaica, between 1966 and 1968.

contributors.title: Trustees of the Natural History Museum

resources.name: media
resources.title: Media
resources.description: Image-level metadata for historical coral reef photographs taken at Discovery Bay, Jamaica, between 1966 and 1968. Media files are stored in the media/ folder and linked to records by fileName.

fields.name: mediaID
fields.description: A unique identifier for the media file.

fields.name: fileName
fields.description: The name of the media file.

fields.name: collectionID
fields.description: A unique identifier for the collection.

fields.name: collectionName
fields.description: The name of the collection.
fields.example: Eileen Graham's Collection, Discovery Bay, Jamaica (1966 to 1968).

fields.name: type
fields.description: The nature of the resource.

fields.name: bibliographicCitation
fields.description: A bibliographic reference for the resource.
fields.example: Johnson, K. and Jones, L.A. (2026) Eileen Graham Collection, Discovery Bay, Jamaica (1966 to 1968). https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22663464.

fields.name: license
fields.description: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the resource.

fields.name: rightsHolder
fields.description: A person or organisation owning or managing rights over the resource.
fields.example: Trustees of the Natural History Museum

fields.name: capturedBy
fields.description: Name or identifier of the person or organisation that captured the media.

fields.name: digitisedBy
fields.description: Name or identifier of the person or organisation that digitised the media.

fields.name: processedBy
fields.description: Name or identifier of the person or organisation that processed the media.

fields.name: year
fields.description: The four-digit year in which the media was captured, according to the Common Era Calendar.

fields.name: month
fields.description: The integer month in which the media was captured.

fields.name: day
fields.description: The integer day of the month in which the media was captured.

fields.name: habitat
fields.description: A category or description of the habitat in which the media was captured.
fields.example: reef flat, reef edge, reef slope

fields.name: waterBody
fields.description: The name of the water body in which the media was captured.

fields.name: islandGroup
fields.description: The name of the island group in which the media was captured.

fields.name: island
fields.description: The name of the island in which the media was captured.

fields.name: country
fields.description: The name of the country or major administrative unit in which the media was captured.

fields.name: countryCode
fields.description: The standard code for the country in which the media was captured (ISO 3166-1-alpha-2).

fields.name: stateProvince
fields.description: The name of the next smaller administrative region than country (state, province, canton, department, region, etc.) in which the media was captured.

fields.name: county
fields.description: The full, unabbreviated name of the next smaller administrative region than stateProvince (county, shire, department, etc.) in which the media was captured.

fields.name: municipality
fields.description: The full, unabbreviated name of the next smaller administrative region than county (city, municipality, etc.) in which the media was captured.

fields.name: locality
fields.description: The specific description of the place.

fields.name: decimalLongitude
fields.description: A geographic longitude (in decimal degrees) as per EPSG:4326 geodetic datum. Always reported in Eastings.

fields.name: decimalLatitude
fields.description: A geographic latitude (in decimal degrees) as per EPSG:4326 geodetic datum. Always reported in Northings.

fields.name: georeferenceRemarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the spatial description determination, explaining assumptions made or the protocol.
fields.example: Coordinates inferred from local feature (buoy), precise to the nearest minute (0.01).

fields.name: minimumDepthInMetres
fields.description: The least depth within a range of depths in metres.

fields.name: maximumDepthInMetres
fields.description: The greatest depth within a range of depths in metres.

fields.name: mediaComments
fields.description: Any comments or notes about the media file.

fields.name: modified
fields.description: Date on which the resource was changed. Formatted as an ISO 8601 string (YYYY-MM-DD).
